notes.title: Version 2.04
notes.content:
- Made the blueness check for items more lenient
- Burning a Ball now gives the correct ash item

notes.title: Version 2.02
notes.content:
Bug Fixes and Tweaks
-----------------------
- Added a line to Lammy the Beaver warning that if you have a heavy inventory you'll need to store some items or build a strong dam to not risk breaking it
- Jonald Lair entrance is now slightly visible after completing Refilling Juice Lake
- Jonald Lair entrance now has a small leak after completing Refilling Juice Lake
- Optimized the Ash Barrel interface to reduce lag when lots of ashes are added
- Increased the interaction area size of Herbert the Whale

notes.title: The Beach Update!!
notes.content:
Cow Life's a beach! In the new Beach Update!
Do you love fast walks on the beach, experiencing the ephemeral nature of our endeavours, and beavers? Then this extensive brand new update is sure to enhance your cow joy!

3 New Quests!

 Help a beaver find love in Beaver Love!
 Arrange the perfect basket formation in Constellation of Basket!
 Completely undo what you did in Drinking Juice Lake in the new quest Refilling Juice Lake!

3 New Skills!

 Swim to new shores with the Swimming skill!
 Build castles and more with the new Building skill!
 Plus one secret bonus skill!

Expanded level cap!

 Train through 20 more handcrafted level experiences and reach new heights!

50 New Items!

 Juice, Weave, Burn, and Build with them all to expand your Experiencing horizons!

And of course, The Beach!

 Meet new friends and swim to your heart's content in this expansive new area!
 Build castles and play with The Ball!
 Enjoy a new tune by musician Vince Alan!
 Be sure to try the Wustard!


Sand, swimming, and the soggiest inventory awaits you!
